UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile preferences stored in Firebase Firestore, including daily browser workout reminder settings.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether daily browser workout reminders are enabled.

reminderTime.description: Daily reminder time in 24-hour HH:mm format.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the user's browser.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile document was last updated.

FitnessProfile.title: FitnessProfile
FitnessProfile.description: User physical metrics, training frequency, equipment, and health limitations for AI Discipline Coach.

FitnessGoal.title: FitnessGoal
FitnessGoal.description: User training sport(s), measurable personal goal, schedule preferences, and program duration in weeks.

sports.description: Optional multi-sport selection (1 to 3 sports, primary sport first).

measurableGoal.description: Optional measurable personal goal specification with baseline and target values.

schedulePreferences.description: Optional real-calendar start date, timezone, preferred free-time window, and session duration budget.

WorkoutPlan.title: WorkoutPlan
WorkoutPlan.description: AI-generated and safety-validated training strategy v2 with 7-day real-calendar execution, versioning, and completion tracking.

sports.description: Optional multi-sport list covered by this plan version.

aiProvider.description: AI provider that generated the plan.

isSimulated.description: True when generated by local/DEV mock AI rather than live Gemini API.

parentPlanId.description: Optional numericId of the previous plan version.

revisionReason.description: Short rationale explaining why this plan version was created.

strategyV2.description: Full-duration Strategy Engine v2 blueprint answering all 8 strategic questions, feasibility, phases, milestones, volume allocation, real-calendar mapping, and daily commitments.

AiConsentRecord.title: AiConsentRecord
AiConsentRecord.description: Versioned user consent record governing AI health data processing, guardian approval for minors, and medical clearance acknowledgement.

DailyGoal.title: DailyGoal
DailyGoal.description: User-defined small daily discipline goal for a specific calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) with completion status.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the goal owner.

dateKey.description: Local calendar date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

title.description: Specific daily micro-goal text (e.g., Uống đủ 2L nước).

completed.description: Whether today's daily goal has been marked as completed.

SmartwatchConnection.title: SmartwatchConnection
SmartwatchConnection.description: User smartwatch connection profile, BLE heart-rate telemetry snapshot, and calendar sync preference.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the smartwatch profile owner.

deviceName.description: Display name of the paired Bluetooth smartwatch or watch platform.

platform.description: Connection or schedule sync mode used with the smartwatch.

autoSyncCalendar.description: Whether calendar exports include wrist reminder alarms.

lastConnectedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent smartwatch connection or schedule sync.

lastHeartRateBpm.description: Most recent real heart-rate reading in BPM (0 when not measured).

lastBatteryPercent.description: Most recent battery percentage from BLE Battery Service (-1 when unavailable).

totalSyncedSessions.description: Total number of workout sessions or schedule exports synced with the smartwatch.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user profile document storing daily reminder configuration, keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/appData/profile.description: User physical profile document (M01) scoped strictly to the owning user.

/users/{userId}/appData/goal.description: User training goal document (M02) scoped strictly to the owning user.

/users/{userId}/appData/consent.description: User AI health-data, guardian, and medical clearance consent record scoped strictly to the owning user.

/users/{userId}/appData/smartwatch.description: User smartwatch connection settings and latest real BLE/calendar sync metadata scoped strictly to the owning user.

/users/{userId}/plans/{planId}.description: User Week 1 AI workout plans and daily check-in progress (M03).

/users/{userId}/dailyGoals/{dateKey}.description: Per-day mini discipline goal and completion status keyed by YYYY-MM-DD.
